notes:
Clearer command feedback and more reliable command-history navigation.

### Improved
- Command results identify the operation, affected geometry and useful values in document units.
- The compact command area shows concise results; Command history keeps detailed prompts, inputs and point coordinates.
- Progress updates stay on one line, and repeated operations remain separate in history.
- Cancellations and Undo/Redo results identify the relevant command.

### Fixed
- Two-finger scrolling in Command history, suggestions and floating menus no longer navigates the viewport behind them.
- Removed redundant completion messages that could replace useful transformation results.
- Layer, property, file and update messages keep their own context while a drawing command is active.

---
Windows x64 installer with signed automatic updates and the corresponding AGPL source code. The installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install choose **More info > Run anyway**.
